lifecycle_correction.cause: A blocked Unix accept retained the listener descriptor after close, so a fast rebind crashed with Address already in use.
lifecycle_correction.red_device_result: Old build failed on lifecycle cycle three.
lifecycle_correction.green_device_result: 20/20 start/stop/rebind cycles passed with invalid-target probes; no app input sent.
lifecycle_correction.fix: Shutdown the listener to wake accept, close active IO, interrupt/wait for the worker to terminate before rebind; no fixed sleep or retry of input.

final_validation.composition: Inputs and keyboard/animation regressions from the corrected stress batch; full suite from its clean repeat. The interrupted first full round is preserved separately.
limits: Device execution validated on Android API 36; older API guards/fallbacks are covered by unit checks and Android lint, not an old-device matrix.

Inputs runs 6–8 encountered host contention while a separate Android Studio Gradle 9.5.1 build used several cores and host swap exceeded 6 GB. The task's idle Gradle 9.8.2 daemon was stopped; both emulators and the other build were preserved. These durations are not a controlled speed comparison.
The original failed prototype and endpoint-rebind stress attempt remain in this record; final results refer to the corrected pinned build only.
